deskripsi: Latihan verbal dan bacaan bahasa Inggris: synonym, antonym, verbal analogy, word classification, logical reasoning, different word, vocabulary, notice, memo, tabel, descriptive text, caution, dan menyusun kalimat.

soal.soal: Secure = ....
soal.penjelasan: Secure (mengamankan) bersinonim dengan protect.

soal.soal: All = ...
soal.penjelasan: All (seluruh) bersinonim dengan entire.

soal.soal: Diligent =...
soal.penjelasan: Diligent (rajin) bersinonim dengan industrious.

soal.soal: Reluctant =...
soal.penjelasan: Reluctant (enggan) bersinonim dengan unwilling.

soal.soal: Transient =...
soal.penjelasan: Transient (sementara, tidak lama) bersinonim dengan temporary. Fleeting juga mirip, soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain (B).

soal.soal: Success >< ...
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata success (keberhasilan) adalah failure (kegagalan).

soal.soal: Never >< ...
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata never (tidak pernah) adalah always (selalu).

soal.soal: Modern >< ...
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata modern adalah ancient (kuno).

soal.soal: Chaotic >< ...
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata chaotic (kacau) adalah orderly (teratur).

soal.soal: Curtail >< ...
soal.penjelasan: Lawan kata curtail (mengurangi/memangkas) adalah expand (memperluas).

soal.soal: Wish is to desire as touch is to ______
soal.penjelasan: Wish bersinonim dengan desire; touch bersinonim dengan feel.

soal.soal: Tobacco plant is to tobacco leaves as rubber tree is to ______
soal.penjelasan: Tanaman tembakau menghasilkan daun tembakau; pohon karet menghasilkan getah (latex).

soal.soal: Gardener : shovel :: tailor : ______
soal.penjelasan: Tukang kebun memakai sekop; penjahit memakai jarum (profesi : alat).

soal.soal: Polar bear : ______ :: camel : ______
soal.penjelasan: Beruang kutub hidup di Arktik; unta hidup di gurun (hewan : habitat).

soal.soal: ______ is to emotion as ______ is to flavour.
soal.penjelasan: Frustration adalah jenis emosi dan savory adalah jenis rasa. Pada pilihan lain, cry/laugh adalah tindakan dan sugar/dessert bukan rasa.

soal.soal: Sarah was feeling ______ after working late into the night.
soal.penjelasan: Setelah 'was feeling' dibutuhkan kata sifat: tired.

soal.soal: One of these words doesn't function as noun; it is...
soal.penjelasan: Aggressive adalah kata sifat; yang lain kata benda.

soal.soal: Choose the word that function as verb below!
soal.penjelasan: Create adalah kata kerja; creator dan creation (noun), creative (adjective).

soal.soal: One of these words doesn't function as adjectives; it is...
soal.penjelasan: Skillful, enjoyable, dan expressive adalah kata sifat; difference adalah kata benda.

soal.soal: Here are verbs, except...
soal.penjelasan: Glorify, glamorize, dan praise adalah kata kerja; glorious adalah kata sifat.

soal.soal: Danielle is younger than Lily. Lily is younger than Karina. Karina is younger than Rose. Who is the third youngest?
soal.penjelasan: Urutan termuda: Danielle, Lily, Karina, Rose. Termuda ketiga adalah Karina.

soal.soal:
No birds are mammals. All eagles are birds.
Which of the following is true?
soal.penjelasan: Elang adalah burung dan tidak ada burung yang mamalia, jadi tidak ada elang yang mamalia.

soal.soal:
Giselle always eats breakfast at 7 a.m. Today she had breakfast at 7 a.m.
Which of the following is a valid inference?
soal.penjelasan: Ia selalu sarapan jam 7 dan hari ini juga jam 7, jadi ia mengikuti rutinitasnya.

soal.soal: If ice melts, the surrounding temperature must be above 0°C. An ice cube is melting. What can we infer?

pilihan.D: The ice melted without any temperature change

soal.penjelasan: Es meleleh hanya jika suhu sekitar di atas 0°C (titik beku).

soal.soal:
When gasoline prices increase, public transport usage rises. Gasoline prices dropped last month.
What is the most likely consequence?
soal.penjelasan: Harga bensin turun, jadi penggunaan transportasi umum menurun.

soal.soal: Which word doesn't belong with the others?
soal.penjelasan: Winter, summer, dan spring adalah musim; sunny adalah cuaca.

soal.soal: What word is the odd one?
soal.penjelasan: Rectangle, parallelogram, dan square adalah bangun datar; cube adalah bangun ruang.

soal.soal: Choose the word that doesn't have the same group!
soal.penjelasan: Guitar, violin, dan cello adalah alat musik berdawai; flute adalah alat musik tiup.

soal.soal: Determine the difference in one word from the following four words!
soal.penjelasan: Axe, sword, dan knife adalah alat/senjata tajam untuk memotong; shovel adalah alat untuk menggali. Soal ini dapat ditafsirkan lain.

soal.soal: Which word doesn't belong with the others?
soal.penjelasan: Gold, iron, dan copper adalah logam; plastic bukan.

soal.soal: A situation where there is no light is described as...
soal.penjelasan: Tidak ada cahaya berarti gelap (dark).

soal.soal: A person who studies celestial objects, space, and the universe is called ...
soal.penjelasan: Orang yang mempelajari benda langit dan alam semesta adalah astronomer.

soal.soal: Moody is...

pilihan.B: Changing attitude or feelings suddenly and often

soal.penjelasan: Moody berarti suasana hati sering berubah tiba-tiba.

soal.soal: Isolate is...

pilihan.C: To separate from other or keep apart

soal.penjelasan: Isolate berarti memisahkan atau menjauhkan dari yang lain.

soal.soal: A large, slow-moving mass of ice is called ...
soal.penjelasan: Massa es besar yang bergerak lambat disebut glacier (gletser).

NOTICE/CAUTION
Read the notice below!

NOTICE: Playground Safety Rules

For your safety, the playground will be closed for cleaning every Wednesday from 10:00 AM to 12:00 PM.
Children must always be supervised by an adult when using the climbing structures.
Please do not bring food or drinks into the play area to avoid attracting insects.
Report any broken equipment to the park staff at the main office immediately.

When is the playground closed, and who should be notified if something is broken?

pilihan.A: Every Wednesday morning; the park staff at the main office
pilihan.B: Every Friday afternoon; the cleaning company
pilihan.C: Every Wednesday morning; the security guard

soal.penjelasan: Taman bermain ditutup setiap Rabu pukul 10.00–12.00 dan kerusakan dilaporkan ke staf taman di kantor utama.

SHORT MESSAGE
Read the short message below!

MEMO
To: All Grade 8 Students
From: Vice Principal Ms. Lisa
Date: 25 May

This is a reminder that starting Monday, May 27, students must wear the full formal school uniform, including black shoes and the official school tie, every Monday and Thursday. Failure to comply will result in loss of break time privileges for that day. Sportswear is only permitted on Wednesdays for P.E. and must be changed out of by lunchtime.

Which statement accurately reflects the uniform rules?

pilihan.A: Black shoes are optional on non-P.E. days
pilihan.B: Sportswear is allowed on both Monday and Wednesday
pilihan.C: Students must wear a tie and black shoes only on special occasions
pilihan.D: Students may only wear sportswear on Wednesday mornings and must change by noon

soal.penjelasan: Pakaian olahraga hanya boleh pada hari Rabu untuk P.E. dan harus diganti sebelum jam makan siang (noon).

DESCRIPTIVE TEXT
Read the text below and answer the following questions!

Bacharuddin Jusuf Habibie, widely known as B.J. Habibie, was an Indonesian engineer and statesman who played a significant role in both the scientific and political arenas of the nation. Born in 1936 in Parepare, South Sulawesi, Habibie demonstrated an early fascination with mathematics and mechanics, leading him to pursue aerospace engineering in Germany, where he achieved remarkable academic success. His career soared in the German aviation industry before he was invited by President Soeharto to return and contribute to Indonesia's technological development.

Upon his return, Habibie became a key figure in the establishment of IPTN (Industri Pesawat Terbang Nusantara), now known as PT Dirgantara Indonesia. His vision was to make Indonesia self-reliant in aviation technology. Under his leadership, the nation witnessed the creation of the N-250, a domestically produced aircraft that symbolized a national aspiration toward technological independence.

When the Asian financial crisis destabilized the country in 1998, Habibie was suddenly thrust into the presidency. His short tenure was marked by difficult decisions, including overseeing East Timor's referendum for independence and implementing political reforms. Though controversial, his leadership laid the groundwork for Indonesia's democratic transition.

Even after leaving office, Habibie remained a revered intellectual. His humility, brilliance, and enduring dedication to science and education made him an icon for many Indonesians. He is remembered not merely as a former president, but as a visionary whose mind never ceased to imagine a better, more advanced Indonesia.

What is the purpose of the text?

pilihan.A: To criticize Habibie's political leadership during the crisis
pilihan.B: To describe the aviation industry in Indonesia
pilihan.C: To narrate B.J. Habibie's life and his contributions in various fields
pilihan.D: To compare B.J. Habibie with other presidents of Indonesia

soal.penjelasan: Teks memaparkan kehidupan Habibie dan kontribusinya di bidang teknologi dan politik.
